description: Figure 6(a), titled “Video type distribution,” is a pie chart that visually represents the proportional breakdown of video types within the benchmark dataset. The chart is composed of a single, solid gray slice that occupies the entire circular area, indicating that all data points within this category fall under one unified type. There are no visible labels, percentage values, or segmented portions within the pie chart itself, nor is there a legend provided to explain what this single category represents. The chart’s purpose is to show the distribution of video types, but due to the visual presentation, it appears to represent only one type, making the proportional breakdown indeterminate from the chart alone.
